## Architectures

<a id="audio-flamingo-3"></a>

### Audio Flamingo 3 Chat

Discusses speech, sounds and music across multiple recordings and can reply with streaming speech.

**Architecture:** AF-Whisper encoder, language model and streaming speech module.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.08128) · [Code](https://github.com/NVIDIA/audio-flamingo/tree/audio_flamingo_3) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/audio-flamingo-3-chat)

<a id="baichuan-audio"></a>

<a id="covo-audio"></a>

### Covo-Audio Chat

Understands spoken requests and generates context-aware, expressive voice responses.

**Architecture:** Continuous-audio encoder and unified speech-language decoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09823) · [Code](https://github.com/Tencent/Covo-Audio) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/tencent/Covo-Audio-Chat)

**Custom / restricted:** code [Tencent research license](https://github.com/Tencent/Covo-Audio/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [Tencent research license](https://github.com/Tencent/Covo-Audio/blob/main/LICENSE) — Academic/research use only; commercial and production use are excluded.

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → T, S · **Interaction:** generation

The selected checkpoint is Covo-Audio-Chat. The paper also describes a distinct Chat-FD full-duplex variant, whose behavior is not assumed for this checkpoint.

**Variants:** Covo-Audio-Chat.

</details>

<a id="dialects2s"></a>

### DialectS2S

Understands and speaks low-resource Chinese dialects in end-to-end voice conversations.

**Architecture:** Dialect-adapted OpenS2S speech-language model.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05177) · [Code](https://github.com/CASIA-LM/OpenS2S) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/CASIA-LM/DialectS2S)

**Open license:** code [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/CASIA-LM/OpenS2S/blob/main/README.md) · weights [MIT](https://huggingface.co/CASIA-LM/DialectS2S/blob/938dc520d99941b9cf8634b8161823adf1a5694e/README.md)

*Family figure — Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05177)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → T, S · **Interaction:** generation

Uses the separately released GLM-4-Voice decoder for speech generation; consult that component’s terms as well. The image illustrates the shared model family; checkpoint-specific changes are described in the model card.

**Variants:** DialectS2S.

</details>

<a id="duplex-cascade"></a>

### DuplexCascade

Coordinates streaming transcription, language generation and speech synthesis for interruptible voice conversations.

**Architecture:** Micro-turn language modeling with streaming ASR and TTS modules.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09180) · [Code](https://github.com/sbintuitions/DuplexCascade) · [Weights](https://huggingface.co/sbintuitions/DuplexCascade)

**Open license:** code [MIT](https://github.com/sbintuitions/DuplexCascade/blob/main/LICENSE) · weights [MIT](https://huggingface.co/sbintuitions/DuplexCascade/blob/31c038ece2f006a28722dd60d1df3868fbb2cc42/README.md)

![DuplexCascade — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/duplex-cascade.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09180)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → T, S · **Interaction:** full-duplex

A fine-tuned Qwen2 dialogue controller plus separately deployed Kyutai ASR and TTS modules. The public checkpoint has an access gate requiring acceptance of publisher terms.

**Variants:** DuplexCascade.

</details>

<a id="hibiki"></a>
